heroHeadline: Bad Bunny Wins Best Latin at 2026 MTV VMAs for "NUEVAYoL"
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny won Best Latin at the MTV Video Music Awards on September 27 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles for "NUEVAYoL," the opening track of DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS, beating Anitta with Shakira, Fuerza Regida, KAROL G, Rosalía and others; he did not attend. It follows the September 5 Creative Arts Emmy sweep, where his Super Bowl LX halftime show took 7 of 9 nominations.
